1: // Minimal "Escape the Grid" game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // Resize to fill container
10:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
11:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
12: 
13:   const PLAYER_RADIUS = 5;
14:   const PLAYER_SPEED = 2;
15:   const WALL_SPEED = 0.5; // scroll speed
16:   const WALL_INTERVAL = 1500; // ms between new wall rows
17:   const GAME_TIME = 60; // seconds
18: 
19:   let player = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 30 };
20:   let walls = [];
21:   let exit = null;
22:   let lastWallTime = 0;
23:   let startTime = null;
24:   let dead = false;
25:   let won = false;
26: 
27:   // Input handling
28:   const keys = {};
29:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
30:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
31: 
32:   function spawnWallRow() {
33:     const cols = 8;
34:     const cellW = canvas.width / cols;
35:     // Randomly decide which cells are solid walls (avoid leaving a path)
36:     const openIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * cols);
37:     for (let i = 0; i < cols; i++) {
38:       if (i === openIdx) continue; // leave a gap
39:       walls.push({
40:         x: i * cellW,
41:         y: -20,
42:         w: cellW - 2,
43:         h: 20,
44:       });
45:     }
46:     // Occasionally place the exit at the top when enough time passed
47:     if (!exit && Math.random() < 0.1) {
48:       exit = {
49:         x: openIdx * cellW + cellW / 4,
50:         y: -30,
51:         w: cellW / 2,
52:         h: 20,
53:         color: 'lime',
54:       };
55:     }
56:   }
57: 
58:   function update(dt) {
59:     if (dead || won) return;
60:     // Player movement
61:     if (keys.ArrowUp) player.y -= PLAYER_SPEED;
62:     if (keys.ArrowDown) player.y += PLAYER_SPEED;
63:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED;
64:     if (keys.ArrowRight) player.x += PLAYER_SPEED;
65:     // Keep inside bounds
66:     player.x = Math.max(PLAYER_RADIUS, Math.min(canvas.width - PLAYER_RADIUS, player.x));
67:     player.y = Math.max(PLAYER_RADIUS, Math.min(canvas.height - PLAYER_RADIUS, player.y));
68: 
69:     // Move walls down
70:     walls.forEach(w => w.y += WALL_SPEED);
71:     if (exit) exit.y += WALL_SPEED;
72: 
73:     // Remove off‑screen walls
74:     walls = walls.filter(w => w.y < canvas.height);
75:     if (exit && exit.y > canvas.height) exit = null;
76: 
77:     // Spawn new wall rows periodically
78:     if (performance.now() - lastWallTime > WALL_INTERVAL) {
79:       spawnWallRow();
80:       lastWallTime = performance.now();
81:     }
82: 
83:     // Collision detection
84:     for (const w of walls) {
85:       if (
86:         player.x + PLAYER_RADIUS > w.x &&
87:         player.x - PLAYER_RADIUS < w.x + w.w &&
88:         player.y + PLAYER_RADIUS > w.y &&
89:         player.y - PLAYER_RADIUS < w.y + w.h
90:       ) {
91:         dead = true;
92:       }
93:     }
94: 
95:     // Exit check
96:     if (exit &&
97:         player.x > exit.x &&
98:         player.x < exit.x + exit.w &&
99:         player.y > exit.y &&
100:         player.y < exit.y + exit.h) {
101:       won = true;
102:     }
103: 
104:     // Time out
105:     const elapsed = (performance.now() - startTime) / 1000;
106:     if (elapsed > GAME_TIME) dead = true;
107:   }
108: 
109:   function draw() {
110:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
111: 
112:     // Draw walls
113:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
114:     walls.forEach(w => {
115:       ctx.fillRect(w.x, w.y, w.w, w.h);
116:     });
117: 
118:     // Draw exit
119:     if (exit) {
120:       ctx.fillStyle = exit.color;
121:       ctx.fillRect(exit.x, exit.y, exit.w, exit.h);
122:     }
123: 
124:     // Draw player
125:     ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
126:     ctx.beginPath();
127:     ctx.arc(player.x, player.y, PLAYER_RADIUS, 0, Math.PI * 2);
128:     ctx.fill();
129: 
130:     // UI
131:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
132:     ctx.font = '12px sans-serif';
133:     const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(GAME_TIME - (performance.now() - startTime) / 1000));
134:     ctx.fillText(`Time: ${remaining}s`, 10, 15);
135:     if (dead) {
136:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
137:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2 - 30, canvas.height / 2);
138:     }
139:     if (won) {
140:       ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
141:       ctx.fillText('You Escaped!', canvas.width / 2 - 40, canvas.height / 2);
142:     }
143:   }
144: 
145:   function loop(timestamp) {
146:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
147:     const dt = timestamp - (lastTimestamp || timestamp);
148:     lastTimestamp = timestamp;
149:     update(dt);
150:     draw();
151:     if (!dead && !won) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
152:   }
153:   let lastTimestamp = null;
154:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
155: })();
